ICCAT stock areas available in the bundled grid

Source: R/domain.R
iccat_stocks.Rd

The package ships the 10051 cells of the official ICCAT 1x1 degree grid (layer grids_01x01 of the ICCAT GIS GeoPackage, cells clipped by the coastline, geodesic area from lwgeom) together with the membership of each cell in every stock area of the GeoPackage. The grid was built with om_domain_from_gpkg() (script data-raw/build_iccat_grid.R) and is identical to the domain of Experimento 02. A cell belongs to a stock area when a point on its surface lies inside the stock polygon (selection = "point_on_surface"); for BET-A (identical to the ICCAT Convention area) membership is the intersection used in Experimento 02 (all cells).

Usage

iccat_stocks()

Value

Data frame with stock_code, layer, name and n_cells.

Examples

iccat_stocks()
#>    stock_code                             layer
#> 1       ALB-M         albacore_tuna_stock_areas
#> 2       ALB-N         albacore_tuna_stock_areas
#> 3       ALB-S         albacore_tuna_stock_areas
